context.transcript:
I heard
A. new restaurant is opening on Fifth Avenue. A. This key will open the lock.
B. I just had lunch there.
C. No, I prefer Italian food.
context.transcript_translation:
我听说
A. 第五大道要开一家新餐厅。 A. 这个钥匙可以打开锁。
B. 我刚才在那里吃过午饭。
C. 不，我更喜欢意大利菜。

items.question: I heard
choices: new restaurant is opening on Fifth Avenue. A. This key will open the lock.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：说第五大道将开新餐厅，答句说 I just had lunch there。 选择理由：B中的 there指该餐厅或地点，直接延续话题；A谈钥匙，C无端否定并谈菜系。正确答案：B（I just had lunch there.）。
